instruction: Candid sports photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Inside a judo dojo with blue wall padding, two male judokas are sparring. On the left, the young man in the white judogi (R2) stands facing right, gripping his opponent's collar. On the right, the middle-aged man in the white judogi (R3) leans forward, facing left, gripping the young man's sleeve. Both maintain focused expressions as they grapple for dominance. The lighting is soft and natural, coming from the side and highlighting their forms against the blue background.
